english.title: Make a false statement in connection with the exercise of functions by a local housing authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in connection with the exercise by **(..SPECIFY HOUSING AUTHORITY..), a local housing authority, of their functions under Part VI of the Housing Act 1996, knowingly or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171(1)(a) and (2) of the Housing Act 1996.
